name: Employment Gold Card
description: Taiwan's Employment Gold Card is a 4-in-1 card combining a work permit, resident visa, Alien Resident Certificate (ARC), and re-entry permit into a single document. It is designed for foreign professionals in 8 qualifying categories, as published by the National Development Council.
tagline: 4-in-1 card for foreign professionals: work, reside, stay, re-enter
keyRequirement: Senior professional in a qualifying field with monthly income of TWD 160,000+ or equivalent expertise
targetAudience: Senior technology professionals (software engineers, data scientists, hardware engineers)

eligibility.label: Professional qualifications in 1 of 8 published categories
eligibility.description: Science & Technology, Economy, Education, Culture & Arts, Sport, Finance, Law, Architecture. Categories are defined by the National Development Council.

eligibility.label: Monthly salary of TWD 160,000+ (~USD 5,300) or equivalent professional credentials
eligibility.description: Published salary thresholds vary by category. Some categories accept alternative qualifications such as patents, awards, or academic publications in lieu of salary.

eligibility.label: No criminal record
eligibility.description: A criminal background check from the applicant's home country is required, authenticated by the relevant TECO office or via Hague Apostille.

eligibility.label: Valid passport
eligibility.description: Must be valid for the duration of the Gold Card term applied for.

eligibilityQuestions.question: Does your professional experience fall within one of the 8 published Gold Card categories (Science & Technology, Economy, Education, Culture & Arts, Sport, Finance, Law, Architecture)?
eligibilityQuestions.helpText: Most technology professionals apply under 'Science and Technology'. The published category definitions are available on goldcard.nat.gov.tw.
eligibilityQuestions.disqualifyingMessage: The published requirements specify that applicants must demonstrate expertise in one of the 8 qualifying fields.

eligibilityQuestions.question: Is your current or most recent monthly salary equivalent to TWD 160,000 (~USD 5,300) or higher?
eligibilityQuestions.helpText: Published salary thresholds vary by category. Some categories accept alternative qualifications (patents, publications, awards) in lieu of salary. Source: goldcard.nat.gov.tw.
eligibilityQuestions.disqualifyingMessage: Some categories have alternative qualification paths beyond salary. Review the specific category requirements on the Gold Card portal.

eligibilityQuestions.question: Can you obtain a criminal background check from your home country?
eligibilityQuestions.helpText: The published requirements include a clean criminal record. The background check must be authenticated by a TECO office or via Hague Apostille.
eligibilityQuestions.disqualifyingMessage: A criminal background check is listed as a required document in the published application requirements.

duration.initial: 1, 2, or 3 years (applicant selects at time of application)

fees.notes: Published fee schedule: 1-year TWD 3,700, 2-year TWD 5,200, 3-year TWD 6,700. Source: goldcard.nat.gov.tw

documents.name: Valid Passport
documents.description: Must be valid for the duration of the Gold Card term

documents.name: Digital Passport Photo
documents.description: 2-inch photo, white background, taken within 6 months. Uploaded during online application.

documents.name: Curriculum Vitae / Resume
documents.description: Detailed professional experience relevant to the qualifying category
tips: Highlight experience directly relevant to the applied category
Include publications, patents, or awards if applicable

documents.name: Proof of Professional Qualifications
documents.description: Salary certificates, employment letters, patents, publications, or award certificates demonstrating expertise in the applied category
tips: Salary proof is the most common — recent pay slips or employer letter stating monthly salary
Community members report that 3 months of pay slips are typically sufficient

documents.name: Criminal Record Check
documents.description: From home country or country of residence, authenticated by the TECO office with jurisdiction over the issuing authority, or via Hague Apostille
tips: Processing times vary by country — allow 2-8 weeks
TECO authentication adds additional processing time

documents.name: Degree Certificate (if applicable)
documents.description: Highest degree certificate, authenticated if required for the specific category
tips: Not always required — depends on which qualification path is used
TECO authentication may be needed for the degree

applicationSteps.title: Submit Online Application
applicationSteps.description: Apply through the Gold Card application portal at goldcard.nat.gov.tw. The portal handles routing to the correct reviewing ministry.
tips: The portal is the only published application channel
Have all documents scanned and ready before starting

applicationSteps.title: Ministry Review
applicationSteps.description: The relevant ministry reviews professional qualifications. For example, the Ministry of Science and Technology reviews Science & Technology applicants.

applicationSteps.title: NIA Processing
applicationSteps.description: The National Immigration Agency processes the resident visa and ARC components after ministry approval.

applicationSteps.title: Receive Gold Card
applicationSteps.description: Collect the physical card at NIA in Taiwan or at a designated TECO office abroad. Card can also be mailed within Taiwan.
tips: If collecting abroad, check with the specific TECO office for availability
Bring passport and a copy of the approval notification

agencySteps.description: The centralized portal routes the application to the correct reviewing ministry based on the selected professional category.

agencySteps.agencyFullName: Relevant Ministry (e.g., Ministry of Science and Technology, Ministry of Labor)
agencySteps.description: The ministry responsible for the selected category reviews professional credentials and qualification evidence.
tips: Science & Technology tends to process fastest according to community reports
Additional documents may be requested during review

agencySteps.description: NIA issues the resident visa and ARC components of the Gold Card after the ministry approves the professional qualification review.

processingTime.notes: Published processing target is 30 working days. Community members report 30-90 days depending on the ministry and whether additional documents are requested. Science & Technology category tends to be processed fastest.

workPermission.notes: The Gold Card includes an open work permit. Holders can work for any employer, freelance, be self-employed, or start a business in Taiwan without a separate work permit.

goldCardFields.taxBenefit: Published tax benefit: For individuals who were not previously Taiwan tax residents, income exceeding TWD 3 million per year is 50% tax-exempt for the first 5 years of holding the Gold Card. (Source: Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals, Article 9)

faqs.question: Can the Gold Card application be submitted from outside Taiwan?
faqs.answer: Yes. The published application process is entirely online through goldcard.nat.gov.tw. The physical card can be collected at a TECO office abroad or at NIA upon arrival in Taiwan.

faqs.question: Is a job offer in Taiwan required to apply?
faqs.answer: No. The Gold Card includes an open work permit, which means holders are not tied to any specific employer. Holders may freelance, start a business, or work for any employer in Taiwan.

faqs.question: What falls under the 'Science and Technology' category?
faqs.answer: Based on published guidelines, this category covers software engineering, data science, hardware engineering, biotechnology, AI/ML, and related technical fields. The reviewing ministry determines whether an applicant's credentials fall within the category.

faqs.question: What is the published tax benefit for Gold Card holders?
faqs.answer: According to the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals (Article 9), first-time Taiwan tax residents holding a Gold Card may have 50% of their annual salary income exceeding TWD 3 million exempt from income tax for up to 5 years. Consult a licensed tax professional (CPA / 會計師) for specific guidance.

faqs.question: Can Gold Card holders apply for APRC (permanent residence)?
faqs.answer: Yes. Published regulations indicate that Gold Card holders may apply for APRC after meeting the continuous residency requirements, which are 3 years for standard Gold Card holders or 1 year for those designated as 'senior professionals'. The 183-day annual presence requirement applies.

faqs.question: What happens when the Gold Card expires?
faqs.answer: The published renewal process allows holders to apply for a new Gold Card before the existing one expires. Alternatively, holders may transition to other residence permit types such as APRC or employer-sponsored ARC.

tips: The Gold Card portal at goldcard.nat.gov.tw is the only published official application channel
Apply under the professional category where credentials are strongest, not necessarily the current job title
Community members report that the Science & Technology category typically processes in 3-4 weeks
If salary is near the threshold, supplementing with patents, publications, or awards may strengthen the application according to community reports
The Gold Card is renewable — there is no published limit on the number of renewals

communityTips.tip: If salary is borderline at TWD 160,000, supplementing with patents, publications, or awards may help — reported by community members on forums
The Gold Card community on Facebook ('Taiwan Gold Card') is an active resource for processing time reports and application tips
Processing times for Science & Technology are typically faster than other categories according to community tracking data

warnings: Gold Card income and qualification requirements vary by professional category
The special tax benefit applies only during the first qualifying period — verify current rules with a tax professional
Processing times vary significantly by professional category
Gold Card does not exempt holders from Taiwan tax obligations

requirements: Submit renewal application before current Gold Card expires
Continue to meet the professional qualification requirements for the chosen category
renewal.processingTime: Similar to initial application (30-60 days reported)
renewal.fees: Same as initial application fee schedule

pathsTo.name: APRC (Permanent Residence)
pathsTo.requirements: Published requirements: continuous residence in Taiwan for 3 years (standard) or 1 year (senior professional designation), meeting the 183-day annual presence average.
pathsTo.notes: The Gold Card provides a shortened path to APRC compared to standard work ARCs (5 years). Published requirements are in the Immigration Act and Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals.

pathsFrom.name: Visitor / Visa-Exempt Entry
pathsFrom.requirements: Apply for Gold Card online from any location. No existing Taiwan visa is required. Published application process is fully online.
pathsFrom.notes: The Gold Card can be applied for from outside Taiwan without any prior visa status.

pathsFrom.name: Work ARC (Employment Permit)
pathsFrom.requirements: Apply for Gold Card while holding a Work ARC. If approved, the Gold Card replaces the Work ARC and provides an open work permit.
pathsFrom.notes: Transitioning from a Work ARC to a Gold Card removes the employer-tied restriction and provides an open work permit.
